text: Human Rights Watch found that PIF-funded businesses and projects are among those exploiting and abusing migrant workers in Saudi Arabia's giga-project construction, including at NEOM, as Vision 2030 projects scale up toward the 2034 FIFA World Cup.

source.name: Human Rights Watch, 'Die First, and I'll Pay You Later': Saudi Arabia's 'Giga-Projects' Built on Widespread Labor Abuses
source.note: Qiddiya itself is not a case study in the report, but the report's finding covers PIF-funded giga-project construction generally; Qiddiya is a PIF giga-project.
